task: Draft a heading, field labels, helper text, and submit button label for a fictional newsletter signup page. Distinguish required from optional fields and state what subscribers receive. Use only the supplied facts; do not add additional consent purposes or posting frequencies.

facts.text: The newsletter is named The Weekly Press Digest.
The email address field is required.
The first name field is optional; it is used to personalize the greeting.
Subscribers receive a weekly editorial digest.
By signing up, subscribers agree that their email address will be used only to send the digest.

forbidden_additions: Additional consent for advertising or third-party sharing not in the supplied facts.
A claim that the first name field is required.
An invented posting frequency different from weekly.
preserve: Email required; first name optional with its stated purpose.
Weekly digest as the subscriber benefit.
Single stated use of the email address.
